scope: Prioritize discoverability and narrowly useful evidence additions for three reader routes. Original gap dispositions remain controlling; no issue closure, new agreement, executed event or visual approval is implied.

priority_definitions.USE_EXISTING_FIRST: Use accepted source content in the current routes; the named independent evidence gap remains.
priority_definitions.OWNER_REVIEW_IF_EXPANDING: An existing proposal or specifically scoped new scenario needs owner acceptance; current route remains usable without it.
priority_definitions.DEFER_NOT_REQUIRED: No new document is justified for the three current routes. Preserve the gap for a specifically requested extension.

priorities.reason: The acquisition bridge can be checked now; absent lender originals only limit independent corroboration.
priorities.source_finding: ARU closing delivery ARU-CL-03 and transaction accounting identify debt payoff, retained leases and funding separately.
priorities.task_unlocked: A closing sources-and-uses reconciliation with a separate column for independently unsupported balances.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the native finance schedule and closing statement; label modeled balances and retain the retained-lease distinction.
priorities.next_action: Link the debt/payoff and lease rows into the acquisition route. Seek a specific lender confirmation or release only if the exercise later tests discharge of security.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: No new instrument is needed for the current route. A fictional confirmation would require separate owner acceptance.

priorities.reason: Separating retention and consulting services from purchase price is immediately useful and already supported.
priorities.source_finding: The transition instrument names eight retention allocations and Fred Tolman’s separate nine-month consultancy; it does not confirm cash payment.
priorities.task_unlocked: A service-compensation versus acquisition-consideration comparison and a schedule of future service conditions.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the retention table, consultancy scope and native finance schedules without adding employees or treating modeled payment timing as bank evidence.
priorities.next_action: Point readers to the retention and consultancy sections; request only the individual service/payment evidence needed for a subsequently selected payment test.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: New employment originals, signatures or payment facts require separate source and owner acceptance.

priorities.reason: The ordinary-inbound agreement supplies concrete billing and duty terms without expanding into excluded uranium service.
priorities.source_finding: The July 7 logistics summary contains rates, clocks, invoice requirements and exclusions; direct uranium-product custody remains OPEN_GATED.
priorities.task_unlocked: A duty-to-evidence review and, separately from the Foundry Field invoice route, a possible future intercompany billing comparison.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use ordinary-inbound service terms only; a planned slot is not a shipment, and a future service period is not performed service.
priorities.next_action: Extract the existing ordinary-inbound obligations for the contract route. Leave uranium transport adoption outside this queue.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Any new product-custody service requires separate operating, legal, safety, insurance and owner authorization.

priorities.reason: Conditional tax treatment is a useful evidence exercise; inventing successful submission would erase the teaching problem.
priorities.source_finding: ARU-CL-07 establishes an internal filing-ready review, not external submission or acceptance.
priorities.task_unlocked: Identify which acquisition-model conclusions depend on an unproved election and what evidence would change that assessment.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the existing tax memorandum and conditional allocation. Retain the no-election alternative as an analysis boundary; do not describe it as a separately delivered workbook.
priorities.next_action: Include the filing-ready distinction in the acquisition route. If a later case needs a resolved outcome, obtain an accepted dated filing-status record through LEGAL-FIELD-005.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: A newly authored fictional filing outcome needs owner acceptance; never manufacture a government confirmation.

priorities.reason: Comparing proposed duties to evidence needed for acceptance is valuable now; pretending a provider executed them is not.
priorities.source_finding: The dossier supplies a proposed master, site orders and schedules; selected provider brands are not verified contracting parties.
priorities.task_unlocked: A draft-contract readiness review, including who must approve price, scope, technical delivery and evidence rights.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the unsigned dossier beside accepted runtime decisions; calculate illustrative examples only in their stated draft/assumption status.
priorities.next_action: Link the proposed schedules as an optional contract comparison; route legal-party/order evidence to existing LEGAL-FIELD-004 before any executed-order scenario.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Provider confirmation is missing. New fictional executed terms or acceptance events require owner acceptance.

priorities.reason: Realistic addressing improves presentation but does not unlock invoice-to-journal tracing, which works with the accepted packet.
priorities.source_finding: PR138 holds the existing field-level proposal; its customer identity and presentation fields are not adopted on the audited main.
priorities.task_unlocked: A future fully addressed invoice example after field adoption and separate visual acceptance.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the exact accepted Foundry Field packet, source invoice ID and customer ID with unavailable fields left explicit.
priorities.next_action: Review the existing proposal version 0.1.0 and SHA-256 23d8d6080ad296468d6b649eda55593d49c33cde0e6b038343ce11e4973e23f8; record accepted/rejected field IDs. Do not create another billing proposal.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Owner acceptance of fields is distinct from acceptance of any changed PDF or workbook.

priorities.reason: A tax calculation requires facts the released invoice does not supply; the existing reconciliation does not need a new tax line.
priorities.source_finding: The packet has no independent tax-master determination; the entity register does not resolve all parent tax treatment.
priorities.task_unlocked: A future tax-bearing invoice scenario with an explicit basis and reconciled financial effect.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Trace existing booked amounts unchanged and record tax treatment as unavailable, not zero or exempt.
priorities.next_action: Keep tax out of the current route. If tax testing is requested, scope one separate proposed scenario through BILL-DEC-003 / LEGAL-FIELD-003 with affected amounts identified.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Owner acceptance and an adequate source basis are required before adopting new treatment or amounts.

priorities.reason: An exact negotiation calendar is unnecessary for the selected ARU exercise or Red Wash purchase-price comparison.
priorities.source_finding: Industrial and mine sources disagree on pre-close day precision; both preserve the closing date and selected consideration.
priorities.task_unlocked: A later dated negotiation-history case, once the conflicting event identities are resolved.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the agreed closing date and amount; present earlier events without selecting one disputed exact day.
priorities.next_action: If a chronology exercise is commissioned, prepare a dated correction matching each disputed event across both sources for owner review.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Do not silently choose dates or rewrite pinned history; accepted correction is required.

priorities.reason: Land settlement would broaden the case but is not needed for the acquisition route; the existing clearing entry demonstrates the current limit.
priorities.source_finding: Accepted runtime canon establishes the fictional acquisition; the finance successor explicitly leaves settlement unresolved.
priorities.task_unlocked: A future land-to-clearing reconciliation, followed by a settlement test only when funding evidence exists.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the $3M planning event and unresolved settlement clearing; the mock deed is neither a bank record nor real title evidence.
priorities.next_action: For an optional land case, link the existing finance bridge. Request a source-specific settlement record through LEGAL-FIELD-009 before proposing a cash, loan or payable counterpart.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Do not reopen accepted fictional ownership. New settlement facts need separate acceptance.

priorities.reason: Title-condition testing is useful later but needs a chosen scheduled right, not a generic fabricated closing binder.
priorities.source_finding: The mine instrument lists transfer limits, scheduled rights and title/environmental escrow mechanics; it does not prove every consent or cure.
priorities.task_unlocked: A future closing-deliverable completeness test for one selected easement, permit or consent.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the instrument and native permit register to identify what must be evidenced, retaining any transfer limitation.
priorities.next_action: Choose one right and trace its native record before requesting a specific consent/cure artifact; preserve the escrow boundary until actual support is accepted.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: New fictional consents or completed cures require owner acceptance; an instrument list is not confirmation.

priorities.reason: Legal perimeter is already sufficient for the exercise; government replicas add no necessary analytical value.
priorities.source_finding: The accepted six-entity formation record and entity register establish the fictional company chain and source-status limits.
priorities.task_unlocked: Identify buyer, target, parent and separate operating ledgers without equating a business-line name with a corporation.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the internal formation record and legal entity IDs; preserve year precision where exact formation day is not established.
priorities.next_action: Link the internal formation record as background; do not commission certificates, seals, state file numbers or government replicas.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: No new document or owner decision is needed for the current exercise.

priorities.reason: An Advisory execution exercise would require new matter-specific paper; the ordinary-inbound agreement already provides concrete terms.
priorities.source_finding: The term sheet specifies contract architecture and the pricing standard supplies policy, not universal executed customer agreements.
priorities.task_unlocked: A future policy-to-SOW completeness comparison for a selected accepted matter.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the standards as requirements, or choose the existing logistics contract route for actual case-specific terms.
priorities.next_action: First select a matter already represented in an accepted scenario, then identify missing SOW fields; only prepare proposed missing terms if that extension is requested.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Matter parties, negotiated terms and execution status cannot be inferred from the standard.

priorities.reason: Cradle’s rights can be understood now; a fixed payment schedule would introduce a separate quantitative scenario.
priorities.source_finding: Canon establishes host authority, equipment ownership and capture-point rights while intentionally leaving permanent price, percentage and tonnage unfixed.
priorities.task_unlocked: A future recovery-rights and host-settlement exercise tied to one explicitly selected quantitative case.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the accepted rights boundary; keep quantitative model assumptions inside their selected scenario.
priorities.next_action: If extending into host settlement, identify the accepted model and its assumption lineage before requesting a scoped agreement through LEGAL-FIELD-006.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Do not convert scenario percentages into permanent canon or host assets into Sable Harbor property.

priorities.reason: Detailed parent investor-rights testing is outside the selected acquisition bridge.
priorities.source_finding: Board minutes record approximate financing approvals and governance boundaries, not complete subscription agreements or side letters.
priorities.task_unlocked: A later board-approval versus definitive-financing-document comparison.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use minutes only for what the Board approved; avoid invented thresholds, dilution mechanics or exact investment terms.
priorities.next_action: Search for a separately accepted definitive source if that exercise is selected; otherwise retain the minutes and gap without generating financing paper.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: New definitive fictional terms require owner acceptance.

priorities.reason: Lease abstraction would be a new exercise requiring unsupported lease terms; plans already serve navigation.
priorities.source_finding: Facility coverage and concept programs distinguish modeled plans from parcel tenure, occupancy dates and construction evidence.
priorities.task_unlocked: A future site-specific lease or property-record review after a tenure source is accepted.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the coverage record to report known site function and exact status; never use a render date as lease or occupancy date.
priorities.next_action: Select a stable site ID and obtain the unresolved tenure evidence through LEGAL-FIELD-007 before preparing lease abstraction material.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: New tenure dates, leases, or construction completion are not authorized by this prioritization.

priorities.reason: Individual grant testing would require recipient and instrument decisions that add nothing to the three current routes.
priorities.source_finding: The carry standard governs phantom economics and eligibility; it does not grant units or settle counsel drafting.
priorities.task_unlocked: A future eligibility and grant-authority exercise after an eligible award has an accepted source.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use the plan as policy only; no individualized serving-J2 preview or implied equity grant.
priorities.next_action: Retain LEGAL-FIELD-008 for any future instrument request; obtain eligibility and authority before proposing an individual award.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Counsel-ready terms and specific owner acceptance are needed before new fictional grants.

priorities.reason: Trademark execution neither unlocks nor improves the three reader exercises.
priorities.source_finding: The operating name is accepted; external clearance and registration remain distinct and unestablished.
priorities.task_unlocked: No current reader task requires a new trademark artifact.
priorities.current_usable_alternative: Use Sable Harbor Advisory as the accepted operating name with the existing clearance-status boundary.
priorities.next_action: Retain the status note. Qualified external review is only needed if real commercialization is pursued.
priorities.acceptance_boundary: Do not invent a clearance opinion, filing or registration, or reopen the operating name.
